title: The Disappointed crowd at the gate
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：disappointed　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 disappointed 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the builder wrote of ① a disappointed crowd at the gate in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more disappointed than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the disappointed ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most disappointed crowd at the gate anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too disappointed to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the disappointed ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a disappointed letter from the school, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as disappointed as the letter from the school they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was disappointed or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something disappointed, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite disappointed; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the disappointed ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, without complaint, she wrote of another disappointed crowd at the gate in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more disappointed than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most disappointed letter from the school in the whole site, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the disappointed ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 失望（前置定语 a disappointed crowd at the gate：1952 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件失望的人群）
B. adj. 失望／沮丧（比较级 more disappointed than：文中两处，一处比门前的人群，一处比预想）
C. adj. 失望／沮丧（最高级 the most disappointed：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 失望（表语 too disappointed to do：母亲觉得它太失望，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 沮丧（前置定语 a disappointed letter from the school：叔叔把整件事称作一桩沮丧的回信）
F. adj. 沮丧（同级比较 as disappointed as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学校的回信相比）
G. adj. 沮丧（后置定语 something disappointed：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 沮丧（受程度副词修饰 quite disappointed：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a disappointed crowd at the gate
the most disappointed crowd at the gate anybody
a disappointed letter from the school
The most disappointed letter from the school in

answers.why: disappointed 意为“失望”，1952 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件失望的人群”，此处作前置定语 a disappointed crowd at the gate。
disappointed 意为“失望”，此处用比较级 more disappointed than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
disappointed 意为“失望”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最失望的一件，故用最高级 the most disappointed crowd at the gate。
disappointed 意为“失望”，母亲认为这件东西“太失望了，谁也用不上”，too disappointed to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
disappointed 意为“沮丧”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩沮丧的回信”，此处作前置定语 a disappointed letter from the school。
disappointed 意为“沮丧”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学校的回信一样沮丧”，同级比较用 as disappointed as。
disappointed 意为“沮丧”，施工图上那半行字要的是“沮丧的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something disappointed。
disappointed 意为“沮丧”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当沮丧”，quite 修饰原级 disappointed。
disappointed 意为“沮丧”，1962 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要沮丧”，故用比较级 more disappointed than。
disappointed 意为“沮丧”，母亲 1964 年说的是“整个工地里最沮丧的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most disappointed letter from the school。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件失望的人群。（a disappointed crowd at the gate）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更失望。（more disappointed than …）
母亲觉得它太失望，谁也用不上。（too disappointed to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩沮丧的回信。（a disappointed letter from the school）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学校的回信一样沮丧。（as disappointed as …）
到了 1959 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件沮丧的东西。（something disappointed）
answers: In 1952 the builder wrote of a disappointed crowd at the gate in the plan.
Everybody said it was more disappointed than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too disappointed to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a disappointed letter from the school.
He said nobody would call it as disappointed as the letter from the school they had once had.
By 1959 the plan asked for nothing but something disappointed.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 disappointed 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the builder wrote of a disappointed crowd at the gate in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most disappointed crowd at the gate in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too disappointed to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a disappointed letter from the school, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite disappointed, and everybody laughed.
The disappointed ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
